text:
mia: quick RFC follow-up — i'm proposing a small, backwards-compatible 'hosting-abi v2' that unifies the surface between Hosted / Dedicated / Private. want a quick ✅/❗ on compatibility strategy and deprecation timeline
jasper: what's the user-visible delta? are we adding fields or changing semantics of routing?
mia: mostly additions: explicit `serving.surface_version` and an optional `local-policy` block for private deployments. default routing semantics remain the same unless policy present.
olivia: private customers (air-gapped/on-prem) can't call control plane to negotiate. the `local-policy` needs to be sufficient for offline negotiation. please avoid any runtime calls to hosted endpoints.
noah: SRE note — need to validate SLO differences. Dedicated currently enforces per-tenant qps guards; Hosted uses dynamic routing. v2 must expose QoS hints so we can surface degradations consistently.
rachel: migration plan idea: (1) support v1 + v2 concurrently for 12 weeks, (2) enable opt-in translation in runtime, (3) gradual tenant opt-in via console flags, (4) deprecate v1 after telemetry baseline looks good.
jasper: runtime translation is doable but beware of edge cases: session-affinity tokens and prefix-caching semantics differ. translation should be explicit and logged.
mia: agree on logs. propose an explicit metric `serving.compat.translate.count` and an event `compat.translate.failure` so we can alert and roll back quickly.
olivia: can we add an `airgap-check` step in the Console deploy flow that validates `local-policy` against on-prem constraints? helps with onboarding.
noah: also add health-check variance metadata: `health.check.window_ms` + `health.slo.p90` so Private/Dedicated operators can tune checks without changing API.
rachel: rollout suggestion: start with internal tenants + 5 customer canaries (1 hosted, 2 dedicated, 2 private) for two weeks. require a short migration checklist per tenant.
devex-bot: quick reference doc: https://redwood.internal/docs/hosting-abi-v2 (WIP) — please append migration checklist there.
jasper: sample `manifest` sketch for v2:
```
serving:
  surface_version: v2
  local_policy:
    router_hint: prefer-local
    qos:
      p90_latency_ms: 120
      max_qps: 500
  health:
    check_window_ms: 5000
    slo_p90_ms: 200
```
mia: concrete decisions so far: 1) implement v2 as additive, 2) runtime translation for common semantics, 3) telemetry + compat metrics mandatory, 4) 12-week dual-support window, 5) airgap/local-policy validation in Console. please call out any holes.
olivia: gap — secrets & KMS: private deployments often use customer KMS/HSM. v2 manifest must not assume hosted KMS; add `kms.provider: customer|redwood` and explicit handshake docs.
noah: ops gap — rolling failover: we need a defined fallback policy when a tenant's v2 manifest contains unsupported qos keys. fallback options: `reject`, `downgrade-to-v1`, `use-defaults`. prefer `reject` with clear error in first week, then `downgrade-to-v1` after canary results.
jasper: agreed. also record which translation rules are lossy so we can show them in migration UI.
mia: thanks — i'll update the RFC with these points and schedule a short design review Weds. tagging @product and @security for KMS/secret concerns.
rachel: thanks all, i'll block canary slots and draft the tenant checklist.
noah: +1, will add SRE runbook for compat incidents.
mia: ok closing loop here — if no objections by EOD tomorrow i'll mark RFC as 'ready for design review'. :thumbsup:
